title: MediTOD Medical Dialogue Annotation
description: Medical history-taking dialogue annotation based on the MediTOD dataset. Annotators label dialogue acts, identify medical entities (symptoms, conditions, medications, tests), and assess doctor-patient communication quality across multi-turn clinical conversations.
